- Annual prepay (1yr): ~18% discount vs monthly

- An upfront prepay for year 1 (60% of committed tokens spend),
- Yearly top-ups to meet the committed ramp (year2 +20%, year3 +20%),
- Minimum monthly usage floors to avoid full clawback, and
- Standard audit and termination clauses (we can share language).

Team —

Ran the numbers against the forecast Karthik shared. High-level takeaways:

- 34% is aggressive; at our current cost curve 34% would meaningfully compress contribution margin in year 1.
- 32% blended discount for a 3-year prepay (with the front-loaded 60% year1 upfront) yields acceptable payback (~13 months) and preserves a 22% contribution margin across the committed volumes assuming the forecasted ramp.
- Recommend we approve 32% contingent on: a signed PO for year1 upfront, explicit quarterly usage floors, and the audit/termination language in the SOW.

I've uploaded the financial model here: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-model-id (Novus model, sensitivity tab).

If leadership wants 34% we can compensate with either longer make-goods windows, higher minimums, or a revenue-sharing clause — not my preferred route.
